claims.claim: Pure Xbox published a piece headlined: The First Six Radio Stations Have Been Revealed For GTA 6, Complete With Audio Previews
claims.evidence: Black Sabbath, Bad Bunny, Slayer and much more! Here we go! Rockstar Games is starting to pull back the curtain on the radio stations for GTA 6 , with six of them having been revealed today along with audio previews for each one - with more to be shared in the near future. We'll definitely be getting more than just six, but there's still a little something for everyone in this initial selection. W

claims.claim: Eurogamer published a piece headlined: For the first time in the series, Grand Theft Auto 6 lets you use headphones to listen to radio stations and podcasts
claims.evidence: GTA 6 will let you listen to radio stations while not in a car, by wearing headphones and earbuds connected to smartphones. GTA 6 also introduces on-demand podcasts, so you can binge true crime while also doing true crime - something like that. Read more

claims.claim: Rockstar says GTA VI will have the series' biggest and widest-ranging selection of in-game radio.
claims.evidence: The Verge quotes Rockstar.
claims.quote: biggest and widest-ranging selection of in-game radio yet

claims.claim: The first six stations are Cocoteo FM, Back Country Radio, AfroBank FM, The Chamber 106.6, Flash FM and Dirty South Classics.
claims.evidence: The Verge lists the six stations.

claims.claim: The stations can be sampled on Rockstar's website alongside six singles from the soundtrack, with artists including Yung Lean and Travis Scott.
claims.evidence: The Verge: sample the stations on Rockstar's website, along with six singles from the official soundtrack.

claims.claim: More stations are to be shared later; the six are a first batch.
claims.evidence: Pure Xbox: six revealed today with more to be shared in the near future.

claims.claim: Rockstar's description of the full line-up spans stations from classic rock to talk radio.
claims.evidence: Pure Xbox quotes Rockstar's statement.
claims.quote: Spanning stations dedicated to everything from Classic Rock to Talk Radio

claims.claim: Cocoteo FM plays modern Latin music, from bachata and merengue to dembow and reggaeton, with hosts El Martillo and La Gata.
claims.evidence: Pure Xbox reproduces the station description.

claims.claim: Back Country Radio plays country music to the Grassrivers and Port Gellhorn, with hosts MW and Delta Dawne and a roving reporter called Mud Dog Mike.
claims.evidence: Pure Xbox reproduces the station description.

claims.claim: AfroBank FM plays African music, from 20th-century classics to amapiano and 3-step, with hosts Burna and Palmsy.
claims.evidence: Pure Xbox reproduces the station description.

claims.claim: The Chamber 106.6 plays classic metal from the 1980s onward, with hosts DJ Kerry and DJ Tom.
claims.evidence: Pure Xbox reproduces the station description.

claims.claim: Flash FM is described as a Vice City institution playing pop, with hosts Robyn and Alex.
claims.evidence: Pure Xbox reproduces the station description.

claims.claim: Dirty South Classics plays regional rap and hip-hop classics, with hosts Trick and Trina.
claims.evidence: Pure Xbox reproduces the station description.

claims.claim: The audio previews include snippets from artists such as Bad Bunny, David Allan Coe, Black Sabbath, Pantera, Slayer, Charli xcx, MGMT and DJ Khaled.
claims.evidence: Pure Xbox lists artists heard in the previews.

claims.claim: Rockstar says GTA VI introduces on-demand podcasts for the first time in the series.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer quotes Rockstar's website.
claims.quote: introduces a series of on-demand podcasts for Jason and Lucia to experience beyond Leonida's terrestrial radio

claims.claim: Radio and podcasts can be heard in vehicles and on foot, through headphones and earbuds connected to the characters' smartphones.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer quotes Rockstar's website.
claims.quote: available to listen to in vehicles and on foot through newly introduced headphones and earbuds connected to their smartphones

claims.claim: Eurogamer, citing Rolling Stone, names real musicians behind the hosts: Bad Bunny and RaiNao, Lana Del Rey, Morgan Wallen and Jeremy Dufrene, Burna Boy and DJ Palms Trax, Kerry King and Tom Araya, Robyn and Alex Consani, and Trina and Trick Daddy.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer lists hosts per station, attributed to Rolling Stone.

claims.claim: GTA VI is due for release on 19 November.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer: edges ever closer to its 19th November release.
